Example Hack 2026

Example Hack is a 48-hour student hackathon on open climate data. Teams of two to five students build tools that make local climate data easier to read and to act on.

Schedule

  • Saturday 09:00: opening and team forming
  • Sunday 21:30: demos and awards

Prizes

PlacePrize
First30,000 TRY
Second15,000 TRY

Participation is free. Apply before the deadline on the application page; mentors from local companies support every team during the event.
